query: SELECT (SELECT state FROM central.step_attempts WHERE id = $1) AS "predecessor!", (SELECT count(*) FROM central.step_attempts WHERE workspace_id = $2 AND predecessor_id = $1 AND state = 'prepared') AS "successors!", (SELECT count(*) FROM central.events WHERE workspace_id = $2 AND kind = 'execution.recovery.prepared_successor_created') AS "evidence!", (SELECT reconciled_epoch FROM central.runs WHERE id = $3) AS "reconciled!"
